stories.title: Voters head to polls in 2026 midterms as Senate and House control hangs in balance
stories.line: Americans are voting in 2026 midterms that will decide control of the Senate and House, with early ballot-counting problems already reported in at least one New York district.

stories.title: US midterm voting begins; control of Congress at stake for Trump's agenda
stories.line: US midterm voting is underway to decide control of Congress, a key test of Trump's agenda and presidency.

stories.line: Google will let schools block its AI tools, but schools that fully block AI will also lose student access to Google Search.

stories.title: Country musician Ketch Secor calls on artists to speak out on guns after Nashville shooting
stories.line: Country musician Ketch Secor is urging other country artists to speak out on gun violence after the Nashville school shooting, despite fear of fan backlash.

stories.title: Trump says U.S. will end $4 billion in military aid to Israel by year's end
stories.line: Trump says the U.S. will end about $4 billion in annual military aid to Israel by year's end, under a new arrangement with Netanyahu.

stories.title: Midterm voting begins as Democrats are favored to take the House and Senate
stories.line: Voters go to the polls in a midterm election widely seen as a referendum on Trump, with Democrats favored to win the House.

stories.title: Oklahoma man charged with mailing hundreds of white-powder letters to officials
stories.line: A man has been charged with mailing hundreds of letters containing white powder to public officials ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Gas tops $4 nationally on Election Day, up 38% since the Iran war began
stories.line: The national average gas price has risen 38% since February's Iran war, with prices varying widely across key Senate states.

stories.line: King Charles called the transatlantic slave trade shameful in a Commonwealth speech but stopped short of the apology campaigners want.
